title: Spectral Cowboy Conductor
description: A glowing, translucent cowboy figure stands centrally within a golden grid structure, wearing a white hat and a suit patterned with map-like shapes. He holds a conductor's baton raised high as musical notes and staves swirl above him, while fragmented cattle, steer skulls, and cowboy boots float among clouds in a luminous sky.
prompt: A luminous ghostly cowboy standing inside a glowing golden grid cage, wearing a white cowboy hat and a suit covered in yellow and purple map-like patterns. He conducts with a sparkling baton as white musical notes and staves swirl around him. Fragmented blue and yellow longhorn cattle, steer skulls, and cowboy boots float through soft pastel clouds in a dreamy sky with yellow and cyan light rays.
